response.text: Let me finish with the payment-to-invoice status check and the payments-vs-journal tie-out.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING (i."STAT_CD"='P' AND (SUM(p."PAY_AMT") IS NULL OR ABS(SUM(p."PAY_AMT")-i."INV_AMT")>0.005)) OR (i."STAT_CD"='O' AND SUM(p."PAY_AMT") IS NOT NULL AND ABS(SUM(p."PAY_AMT")-i."INV_AMT")<=0.005) OR (i."STAT_CD"='V' AND SUM(p."PAY_AMT") IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100
